## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (lint, type check, tests)
- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior, including failure paths
- [ ] User-visible changes have an entry under `## [Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] The version in `package.json` is unchanged (it changes only in release commits)
